dct_description_sm: The Strength of Many initiative involved developing a climate change adaptation plan (CCAP) for the Fort Albany First Nation (FAFN). The need in Fort Albany First Nation for a vision for planning and specifically adaptation planning was paramount for this community so close to the sea, and so dependent on the land and water for its overall health and well-being. While all remote First Nations experience some degree of vulnerability, the housing shortages, water quality issues,  rates of suicide, and repeated evacuations of the First Nations on the coast of James Bay in Ontario were well known and indicated extreme vulnerability.
